task.title: Page complete finite recurrence histories through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1013 by exposing bounded recurrence-history pages as deterministic read-only JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validate a positive at-most-1024 page size and optional exact recurrence-ID cursor before storage access.
Emit exact-ID-ordered complete revision-bearing creation and cancellation evidence plus nullable exclusive continuation.
Preserve missing-storage non-creation and fail without partial stdout on selected or lookahead corruption.

attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected recurrence history-page because the subcommand did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added integration tests for active and cancelled evidence, ordering, escaping, continuation, empty and terminal pages, validation, missing storage, and corruption boundaries.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the read-only adapter.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented pre-storage validation, one read-only histories_page delegation, deterministic compact JSON, and shared exact/paged recurrence history-entry conversion.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 1013 in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with CLI tests, ADR-0104, and scheduler documentation; independent pre-commit review found no blocking issue.

attempts.diagnostic: A review-limit false green was excluded; after cooldown and shared-budget availability, CodeRabbit run 0912870f-8e9d-4915-adc4-38d114b05d0f reviewed exact head 93c3ccc with no actionable comments and zero unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge disabled until exact-head Rust CI, genuine review, and zero-thread readiness were established.

outcome.summary: Issue 1013 exposed bounded complete recurrence-history pages without creating storage or adding write authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 1014 exact head 93c3ccccf67969d2552089dc0b26cd2076a73cab

lessons: A dedicated history-page command keeps bounded audit discovery distinct from exact history lookup and current recurrence inventory.
Reusing typed entry conversion preserves exact field names and fails closed when future history variants are unsupported.
The cursor advances between complete recurrence histories; it is not an event-level cursor or durable snapshot token.
The adapter creates no storage, persists no cursor, reads no clock, and adds no lifecycle, worker, dispatch, retry, permission, or execution authority.
